title: Hurricane Florence
description: Alaska Air National Guard personnel from Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska, prepare their HC-130J for any Hurricane Florence misison when tasked Sept. 14, 2018, at Dover Air Force Base, Del.
